## Trinity Capital Inc. Provides Equipment Financing to LuxWall to Assist in Hyper-Scaling Transparent Insulation


Aug 27, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.trinitycap.com/node/11306/pdf)


PHOENIX


, Aug. 27, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Trinity Capital Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760355-1&h=1820251594&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftrinitycapital.com%2F%3Futm_source%3DPR%26utm_medium%3DPortfolio_Announcement%26utm_campaign%3DLuxWall&a=Trinity+Capital+Inc.) (NYSE: TRIN) (the "Company"), a leading international alternative asset manager, today announced an equipment financing commitment to[LuxWall](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760355-1&h=1714772671&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.luxwall.com%2F&a=LuxWall) , a pioneer of Transparent Insulation.


LuxWall develops and manufactures Transparent Insulation scienced with vacuum insulation technology to improve building energy performance while delivering meaningful economic value to property owners. By reducing heating and cooling energy use, LuxWall can help lower operating expenses, increase net operating income (NOI), and increase property value. The ultra-slim profile of LuxWall Transparent Insulation allows it to be seamlessly integrated into many existing window frames, enabling property owners to significantly improve building energy efficiency and help reduce street noise and interior condensation. LuxWall products are designed for residential and commercial buildings, including offices, multifamily housing, university campuses, healthcare systems, retail locations, and buildings in the public sector.


"We believe LuxWall is tackling a problem that hides in plain sight - turning windows from an energy liability into part of the solution," said Ryan Little, Senior Managing Director, Equipment Finance at Trinity Capital. "We have been impressed by both the LuxWall team and their technology, and we look forward to supporting them as they scale and bring their products to more of the market."


The financing will support LuxWall's continued manufacturing expansion, increasing production capacity to meet growing global demand for Transparent Insulation and accelerating its deployment across the built environment.


"This financing marks another important step in scaling Transparent Insulation and making high-performance building efficiency more accessible," said Scott Thomsen, Founder & CEO of LuxWall. "Trinity Capital's support enables us to expand production and bring our technology to more buildings around the world. By transforming one of the largest sources of energy loss in buildings into an opportunity for greater efficiency and stronger building economics, we're advancing our mission to deliver energy efficiency for all."


**About Trinity Capital Inc.** Trinity Capital Inc. (NYSE: TRIN) is an international alternative asset manager that seeks to deliver consistent returns for investors through access to private credit markets. Trinity Capital sources and structures investments in well-capitalized growth-oriented companies across five distinct lending verticals: Tech Lending, Equipment Finance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Sponsor Finance, and Asset Based Lending. As a long-term, trusted partner for innovative companies seeking tailored debt solutions, Trinity Capital has deployed more than $6.2 billion across over 490 investments since inception in 2008 (as of June 30, 2026). Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, Trinity Capital's dedicated team is strategically located across the United States and Europe. For more information on Trinity Capital, please visit[trinitycapital.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760355-1&h=123100335&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftrinitycapital.com%2F%3Futm_source%3DPR%26utm_medium%3DPortfolio_Announcement%26utm_campaign%3DLuxWall&a=trinitycapital.com) and stay connected to the latest activity via[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760355-1&h=13254684&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Ftrinity-capital-inc%2F&a=LinkedIn) .


**About LuxWall**
Headquartered in Ypsilanti, MI, USA, LuxWall is focused on product development, scaling, and commercialization of innovative energy-efficient products and solutions for the built environment. LuxWall's Transparent Insulation provides a step change in energy performance by eliminating or significantly reducing convective, conductive, and radiative heat gain and heat loss in buildings. LuxWall manufactures its Transparent Insulation product line at its Litchfield, Michigan manufacturing plant, and is constructing its second manufacturing plant in Detroit, Michigan.


Learn more at[www.luxwall.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760355-1&h=2400312431&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.luxwall.com%2F&a=www.luxwall.com)
